About Us
Constituent of Symbiosis International (Deemed University), Symbiosis Institute of Design, Pune, is a premier institution that equips aspiring designers with the knowledge, skills, and experiences needed to succeed in the ever-evolving world of design. By creating an enabling atmosphere for students with the right bent of mind to hone their skills and capabilities to turn them into competitive professional designers, SID stands as a beacon of creativity and innovation in the realm of design education. We are dedicated to nurturing the next generation of designers through a blend of rigorous academics and hands-on experience.

Dr. Sanjeevani Ayachit
Director, Symbiosis Institute of Design
Dean - Faculty of Architecture and Design, Symbiosis International (Deemed University), Pune.
Dr. Sanjeevani Ayachit is currently the Director at the Symbiosis Institute of Design and Dean of the Faculty of Architecture and Design at Symbiosis International (Deemed University). She holds a PhD from SIU, a Master's degree in Clothing and Textiles from M. S. University of Baroda and over 20 years of experience in the field of apparel design, design education and consultancy.

Dr. Sanjeevani started her career at the men's apparel company Raymond Apparel Ltd. (RAL) in Thane, where she oversaw their finishing and quality control department. On moving to Pune, she taught apparel and textile design at the S. N. D. T. College of Home Science and INIFD, Pune. She also worked as Manager – Quality Control at Sleepins Apparel Pvt. Ltd.

Dr. Sanjeevani headed the departments of Fashion Design and Fashion Communication at SID for several years and also served as the Deputy Director. Her PhD explores the cross-cultural subtleties of costumes of the Peshwas of Pune. Her research interests lie in the areas of heritage Indian textiles and costumes, fashion design process, design thinking and inclusive design. An avid reader and researcher, Sanjeevani has co-authored a book documenting the historic textiles and costumes in the collection of the Kelkar Museum in Pune, India. She has presented research papers at several conferences and published her research in reputed journals. She is presently guiding 6 doctoral students across diverse areas like fashion forecasting, adaptive clothing, craft revival, sustainable fashion and enclothed cognition. She has been a panelist at several industry and academia forums, member of Board of Studies, PhD thesis examiner, and also reviewed research papers for international journals. Her robust industry connections and strong alumni connect keep her well in touch with design industry developments.

Sanjeevani is an avid traveler and in her free time she listens to music, practices yoga, and loves to cycle through the lanes of Pune.

About SID
Constituent of Symbiosis International (Deemed University), Symbiosis Institute of Design, Pune, is a premier institution that equips aspiring designers with the knowledge, skills, and experiences needed to succeed in the ever-evolving world of design. By creating an enabling atmosphere for students with the right bent of mind to hone their skills and capabilities to turn them into competitive professional designers, SID stands as a beacon of creativity and innovation in the realm of design education. We are dedicated to nurturing the next generation of designers through a blend of rigorous academics and hands-on experience.
The institute offers programmes at both undergraduate as wells as post graduate level. The four year Bachelor of Design (B. Des.) programme is offered in four disciplines like Communication Design, Industrial Design, Fashion Design and Fashion Communication. The Master of Design (M. Des.) programme is offered with a specialization in User Experience Design. Our multidisciplinary campus offers opportunities to students of different streams to share ideas, brainstorm solutions and catalyze each other’s thinking. The work ambience enables one to build on one’s conventional skills and complimented with modern tools and techniques allows the student to be on the cutting edge of Design.
The design curriculum at SID generates avenues to incubate original thoughts and implement design knowledge and skills on a creative platform. The simulative environment galvanizes students to imbibe contemporary skills while exploring non–conventional techniques to achieve design goals.
The curriculum aims at creating professionals who with their creative impulse and skillful ability participate and contribute to the highly dynamic and competitive world of design. This is ensured by a team of professional faculty who instruct, inspire and mentor students utilizing their technical and design expertise while also encouraging the development of individual style. The well-stocked library, access to latest research databases, state-of-the-art infrastructure, labs, studios and workshops ensure a conducive learning environment where students can nurture their creative ideas to fruition. This has ensured that SID holds a coveted position among the top design schools in the country. Several courses are supported by leading industry practitioners and many others have well known visiting lecturers. Internships and design projects are built into the curriculum to ensure industry exposure and field trips and industrial visits add on to the professional experience. An active Industry Interaction Cell ensures a continuous dialogue with the industry and assists students in securing internships and placement opportunities. SID is also a member of several national as well as international professional networks which benefit the students in terms of opportunities for participation in design competitions, design events, conferences and seminars thus enhancing their outlook towards the dynamic nature of the design field. This approach ensures that graduates are not only skilled designers but also adept at navigating the professional landscape. The vibrant campus life, combined with Pune's rich cultural heritage, makes SID a stimulating place to study and grow as a designer.
